              ↥(GeneratedFoundations.Operations.PreparedTraceForm.Traceless

              (n + 1) ^ 2 ∧

                (K :
                  ↥(GeneratedFoundations.Operations.PreparedTraceForm.Hermitian
                      (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.FiniteLadderAlgebra.Index n))),
                0 ≤
                  ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsConnectedResponse.sourceResponse hb n t))
                        0)
                      K)
                    K) ∧
              (∀
                  (K :
                    ↥(GeneratedFoundations.Operations.PreparedTraceForm.Hermitian
                        (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.FiniteLadderAlgebra.Index n))),
                  (∀
                      (L :
                        ↥(GeneratedFoundations.Operations.PreparedTraceForm.Hermitian
                            (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.FiniteLadderAlgebra.Index n))),
                      ((fderiv ℝ
                              (fderiv ℝ (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsConnectedResponse.sourceResponse hb n t))
                              0)
                            K)
                          L =
                        0) ↔
                    ∃ r,
                      (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.SourceFiniteLadder.corner hb n) ↑K =
                        r • GeneratedFoundations.Operations.SourceFiniteLadder.projection hb n) ∧

GeneratedFoundations.Operations.SourceSpinCorner.hermitian_traceless_span
  (M : GeneratedFoundations.Operations.SourceSpinCorner.Mat2) (hM : Matrix.conjTranspose M = M)
  (ht : Matrix.trace M = 0) :
  M =

  (P : ↥GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceCliffordChirality.evenSourceAlgebra) (hP : P * P = P) :

  ∃ B,
    (∀
        (f :
          ↥(GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.ComplexIntervalL2 (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLeft b)
              (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowRight b))),
        f ∈
            GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumannDomain (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLeft b)
              (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowRight b) ↔
          Summable fun n =>
            GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.neumannEigenvalue (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLengthGenerated b) n ^
                2 *
              ‖inner ℂ (B n) f‖ ^ 2) ∧
      ∀
        (f :
          ↥(GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumannDomain (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLeft b)
              (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowRight b)))
        (n : ℕ),
        inner ℂ (B n) ((GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumannOperator ⋯).toFun f) =
          ↑(GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.neumannEigenvalue (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLengthGenerated b) n) *
            inner ℂ (B n) ↑f
